usedFor: PagerDuty holds incidents, and Google Sheets keeps a log of them through “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incident Instant” in PagerDuty, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new incident adds a row, giving you a running record to sort and review.

watchOut: “New Incident acknowledged” is its own trigger and adds its own rows, so one incident can appear twice.
